_meta.title: MCP server recommendations — stack signal → server map
_meta.notes: Derivative work — distilled from the upstream markdown into a structured signal→recommendation table for ai-kit's recommend-tools scorer. Re-vendor (refresh pin + content) only with explicit user confirmation.

recommendations.name: context7
recommendations.best_for: Projects using popular libraries/SDKs where Claude should code against up-to-date docs
recommendations.value: Live documentation lookups instead of relying on training data — reduces hallucinated APIs and outdated patterns.

recommendations.name: playwright
recommendations.best_for: Frontend projects needing browser automation, testing, or screenshots
recommendations.value: Claude can interact with the running app, take screenshots, fill forms, verify UI.

recommendations.name: puppeteer
recommendations.value: PDF generation, scraping, headless CI tests.

recommendations.name: supabase
recommendations.value: Query tables, manage auth, interact with Supabase storage directly.

recommendations.name: postgresql
recommendations.best_for: Direct PostgreSQL database access (no ORM, raw migrations, data analysis)
recommendations.value: Inspect schema, run queries, debug data issues directly.

recommendations.name: github
recommendations.value: Create issues, review PRs, check workflow runs, manage releases.

recommendations.name: linear
recommendations.best_for: Teams using Linear for issue tracking

recommendations.name: sentry
recommendations.value: Investigate Sentry issues, find root causes, suggest fixes.

recommendations.name: slack
recommendations.best_for: Slack workspace integration — notifications, deploy alerts, incident posts
